species.name: Bangau bluwok
species.summary: Bangau bluwok adalah sejenis burung dari suku Ciconidae. Burung ini biasa dijumpai di perairan dangkal, sungai, pantai pasir, rawa dan sawah berlumpur. Burung ini memakan ikan, katak dan hewan air lainnya.

species.name: Kura-kura Ambon
species.summary: The Amboina box turtle (Cuora amboinensis), or southeast Asian box turtle is a species of Asian box turtle.

Limnonectes microtympanum (common name: Sulawesi wart frog) is a species of frog in the Dicroglossidae family. It is endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia, where it is only known from the Moncong Lompobatang mountain at elevations above 1,000 m (3,300 ft).

species.name: Anoa gunung
species.habitat: Dense tropical montane forest, often in steep, rugged terrain with thick undergrowth providing cover; prefers areas near water sources and away from human disturbance.
species.summary: Anoa pegunungan adalah salah satu dari dua jenis spesies anoa yang hidup di Indonesia. Mamalia ini dikenal juga dengan nama Mountain Anoa, Anoa de Montagne, Anoa de Quarle, Berganoa, dan Anoa de Montaña.

species.name: Kedidi Golgol
species.summary: The curlew sandpiper (Calidris ferruginea) is a small wader that breeds on the tundra of Arctic Siberia. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris, a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds.

species.name: Kalong Sulawesi
species.habitat: Primarily inhabits lowland and foothill primary tropical rainforests, but also uses secondary forests and forest edges. It requires large, undisturbed trees for roosting and relies on mature forest for food resources such as ripe figs and other forest fruits.
species.summary: Kalong sulawesi (Acerodon celebensis) adalah sebuah spesies codot yang endemik dari Indonesia. Spesies ini diklasifikasikan sebagai "Rentan" oleh IUCN karena tingkat perburuan yang tidak berkelanjutan.
The D'Abrera's tiger (Parantica dabrerai) is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Rabdion forsteni is a species of snake in the family Colubridae.

Hylarana macrops is a species of true frog in the genus Hylarana. It is native to Sulawesi, Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and rivers. It is threatened by habitat loss.
Lipinia infralineolata is a species of skink found in Indonesia.

species.name: Pergam Hijau
species.summary: Pergam hijau adalah spesies burung yang terdapat di sebagian besar wilayah Indonesia, bulu bagian atas punggung dan ekor bagian bawah berwarna cokelat tua.

species.name: Kedidi Leher-Merah
species.summary: Kedidi leher-merah (bahasa Latin = Calidris ruficollis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Calidris. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan Moluska, krustasea yang memiliki habitat di gosong lumpur, muara pasang surut, tambak, mangrove.
The Sulawesi leaf warbler (Phylloscopus sarasinorum) is a species of Old World warbler in the family Phylloscopidae. It is found only in Sulawesi Island, Indonesia.

species.name: Bangau sandang-lawe
species.summary: Bangau sandang-lawe (Ciconia episcopus) adalah spesies burung dari suku Ciconiidae. Dalam taksonomi, bangau sandang-lawe termasuk dalam genus Ciconia. Bangau sandang-lawe merupakan burung pemakan ikan, katak, moluska, serangga, yang berhabitat di sawah, padang rumput, dataran rendah, perbukitan.
Sikatan leher-merah (Ficedula rufigula) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Muscicapidae. Burung ini endemik di Pulau Sulawesi.
Sphenomorphus nigrolabris is a species of skink found in Indonesia.

species.habitat: Primarily found in tropical montane and submontane rainforest, favoring areas with dense leaf litter and moist forest floor conditions. It is closely associated with primary forest and appears sensitive to habitat disturbance.
species.summary: Crunomys celebensis is a small, insectivorous shrew-like rodent endemic to the tropical forests of Sulawesi, Indonesia. It belongs to a distinctive genus of 'shrew rats' that have evolved a body plan convergent with true shrews, featuring a long pointed snout and reduced eyes.

Tropidophorus baconi, also known commonly as Bacon's water skink or Bacon's waterside skink, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Sphenomorphinae of the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Sulawesi (Indonesia).

species.name: Tekukur
species.summary: Tekukur Biasa (bahasa Inggris: spotted dove; Spilopelia chinensis) adalah sejenis burung merpati kecil yang mempunyai paruh, berekor agak panjang, berdarah panas, dan bereproduksi dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Cekakak Sungai
species.summary: Cekakak sungai (bahasa Latin = Todirhamphus chloris) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Alcedinidae, dari genus Todirhamphus.

species.name: Bondol Peking
species.summary: Bondol peking atau pipit peking (Lonchura punctulata) adalah sejenis burung kecil pemakan padi dan biji-bijian. Nama punctulata berarti berbintik-bintik, menunjuk kepada warna bulu-bulu di dadanya.

species.name: Walet Sapi
species.summary: Walet sapi (Collocalia esculenta) adalah sejenis burung anggota suku Apodidae. Burung ini menyebar luas di Australia, Brunei, Burma, Christmas Island, Filipina, India, Indonesia, Kaledonia Baru, Malaysia, Papua Nugini, Singapura, Kepulauan Solomon, Thailand, dan Vanuatu.

species.name: Blekok
species.summary: Blekok sawah (Ardeola speciosa) adalah spesies burung dari famili Ardeidae. Makanan utamanya adalah serangga, ikan, dan kepiting. Burung ini menyebar luas di Asia Tenggara. Panjang tubuh sekitar 46 cm. Paruh berwarna kuning dan hitam pada ujungnya. Pada masa tidak berbiak warna punggung lebih kecokelatan.

species.name: Elang bondol
species.summary: Elang bondol (Haliastur indus) adalah spesies burung pemangsa dari famili Accipitridae.

species.name: Perkutut
species.summary: Perkutut jawa (Geopelia striata) adalah spesies burung dalam suku Columbidae, dari genus Geopelia. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan biji-bijian saja, akan tetapi tidak tertutup kemungkinan jika burung ini juga memakan serangga di habitat aslinya.

species.name: Kuntul Kecil
species.summary: Kuntul kecil (Egretta garzetta) adalah sejenis burung dari suku Ardeidae (kerabat cangak). Disebut Little Egret dalam bahasa Inggris, burung ini mempunyai ‘kembarannya’ di Dunia Baru, yakni kuntul salju atau Snowy Egret (Egretta thula) dari Karibia.

species.name: Trinil Pantai
species.summary: Trinil pantai (bahasa Latin = Actitis hypoleucos) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Actitis. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan krustasea, serangga, invertebrata lain yang memiliki habitat di habitat luas.

species.name: Burung-Madu Kelapa
species.summary: Burung-madu kelapa (Anthreptes malacensis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Nectariniidae, dari genus Anthreptes. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan nektar Loranthus, Musa, Hibiscus, serangga, ulat, laba-laba, buah lembu dan memiliki habitat di pekarangan terbuka, kebun kelapa, semak pantai, hutan mangrove.

species.name: Kareo Padi
species.summary: Kareo Padi atau Ruak-ruak (Amaurornis phoenicurus) kabuburak/burak-burak bahasa Banjar adalah spesies burung yang masuk dalam famili Rallidae. Burung ini tersebar di India, China selatan, Asia Tenggara, Filipina, Kalimantan,Sulawesi, Sunda Besar dan Nusa Tenggara.

species.name: Cangak Merah
species.summary: Cangak Merah adalah spesies burung Kuntul yang berukuran besar, yakni 78–97 cm. Warna abu-abu coklat berangan. Iris kuning, paruh coklat, kaki coklat kemerahan. Bulu lainnya pada burung ini berwarna coklat kemerahan. Terdapat setrip hitam menurun sepanjang leher yang merah-karat khas.

species.name: Kirik-Kirik Laut
species.summary: Kirik-kirik laut (Merops philippinus) adalah sebuah spesies burung dari genus Merops dalam famili Meropidae. Habitat kirik-kirik laut pada daerah terbuka yang dekat dengan perairan. persawahan, rawa, atau hutan bakau. Kirik-kirik laut dapat ditemukan hingga ketinggian 1.200 meter di atas permukaan laut.

species.name: Remetuk Laut
species.summary: Remetuk Laut (Gerygone sulphurea) adalah jenis burung pengicau dalam famili Acanthizidae, memiliki suara yang nyaring dan khas. Burung ini tersebar di Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapura, Brunei, Filipina, dan Thailand.

species.name: Cangak besar
species.summary: The great egret (Ardea alba), also known as the common egret, large egret or (in the Old World) great white egret or great white heron is a large, widely distributed egret, with four subspecies found in Asia, Africa, the Americas, and southern Europe.

species.name: Tokek Rumah
species.summary: Tokek rumah atau lebih sederhana tokek adalah sejenis reptil yang masuk ke dalam golongan cecak besar, suku Gekkonidae. Tokek rumah memiliki nama ilmiah Gekko gecko (Linnaeus, 1758). Istilah tokek dalam bahasa sehari-hari biasanya mengacu kepada hewan ini.

species.name: Kapasan Sayap-Putih
species.summary: Kapasan sayap-putih Nama Lokal : Mpepe Dlaam bahasa inggris White-shouldered Triller (bahasa latin : Lalage sueurii) adalah spesies burung yang termasuk dalam famili Campephagidae. Burung ini endemik di Indonesia, tersebar di Jawa, Bali, Nusa Tenggara, dan Sulawesi.

species.name: Tepekong Jambul
species.summary: Tepekong jambul (bahasa Latin = Hemiprocne longipennis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Hemiprocnidae, dari genus Hemiprocne. Burung ini memiliki habitat di hutan, hutan terbuka dengan pohon tinggi. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

species.name: Cekakak Suci
species.summary: The sacred kingfisher (Todiramphus sanctus) is a medium-sized woodland kingfisher that occurs in mangroves, woodlands, forests, and river valleys in Australia, New Zealand, and other parts of the western Pacific. In New Zealand the species is also known by its Māori name kōtare.

species.name: Decu Belang
species.summary: Decu Belang ( Saxicola caprata ) adalah burung pengicau ditemukan mulai dari Asia Barat dan Asia Tengah ke Asia Selatan dan Tenggara. Ini adalah burung akrab pedesaan dan scrub terbuka atau padang rumput .

species.name: Elanglaut perut-putih
species.summary: The white-bellied sea eagle (Icthyophaga leucogaster), also known as the white-breasted sea eagle, is a large diurnal bird of prey in the family Accipitridae.

species.name: Srigunting Jambul-Rambut
species.summary: Srigunting jambul-rambut (Dicrurus hottentottus) adalah burung Asia pada familia Dicruridae. Spesies ini dahulu dianggap sejenis dengan Dicrurus bracteatus, dengan nama "Srigunting Kelip" – yang dahulu digunakan pada kedua spesies itu – yang sekarang namanya sudah disediakan.

species.name: Kapinis Rumah
species.summary: Kapinis rumah (bahasa Latin = Apus nipalensis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Apodidae, dari genus Apus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil yang memiliki habitat di daerah terbuka, pesisir, perkotaan, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

species.name: Cinenen Gunung
species.summary: The mountain tailorbird (Phyllergates cuculatus) is a songbird species formerly placed in the "Old World warbler" assemblage, but is now placed in the genus Phyllergates in the family Cettiidae.

species.name: Delimukan Zamrud
species.summary: Delimukan zamrud atau disebut juga burung walik adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur. Burung ini dalam bahasa inggris disebut emerald dove karena warnanya yang hijau seperti zamrud.

species.name: Gajahan penggala
species.summary: Gajahan pengala (Numenius phaeopus) adalah spesies burung perancah yang termasuk dalam famili Scolopacidae. Burung ini adalah salah satu jenis gajahan yang paling menyebar luas, berbiak di wilayah-wilayah subarktik di Amerika Utara, Asia dan Eropa.

species.name: Trinil Semak
species.summary: Trinil semak (bahasa Latin = Tringa glareola) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Tringa. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan cacing, larva serangga, berudu, krustasea yang memiliki habitat di pantai berlumpur, sawah, rawa air tawar. tersebar sampai ketinggian 750 m dpl.

species.name: Itik Benjut
species.summary: Itik benjut (bahasa Latin = Anas gibberifrons) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Anatidae, dari genus Anas. Itik benjut merupakan burung pemakan tumbuhan dan invertebrata yang memiliki habitat di rawa, payau, mangrove, tambak, kolam, sungai. Dapat sampai jauh ke pedalaman

species.name: Cici Merah
species.summary: Cici merah: 325, : 360 (Cisticola exilis) adalah nama sejenis burung pengicau yang bertubuh kecil mungil. Pada musim berbiak, burung jantan memiliki bulu-bulu kuning emas terang pada mahkotanya.: 325 Karenanya, dalam bahasa Inggris dinamai sebagai Golden-headed Cisticola,: 360 Bright-headed Cisticola, atau Bright-cappe…

species.name: Kacamata Laut
species.summary: Kacamata laut (Zosterops chloris) adalah spesies burung dalam familia Zosteropidae. Ia Endemik di Indonesia, yakni di Selat Sunda hingga Kepulauan Aru.

species.name: Bondol Rawa
species.summary: The chestnut munia (Lonchura atricapilla), formerly considered as a subspecies of the tricoloured munia, is also known as black-headed munia.It is a small passerine bird.

species.name: Kicuit Batu
species.summary: Kicuit batu (Motacilla cinerea) adalah anggota kecil dari famili kicuit, Motacillidae. Spesies ini kelihatan sama dengan Kicuit kuning, tetapi ada warna kuning yang dibatasi pada tenggorokan sampai kloaka. Jantan saat perkembangbiakan memiliki tenggorokan hitam.

species.name: Cabai Panggul-Kelabu
species.summary: Cabai panggul-kelabu (Dicaeum celebicum) adalah salah satu spesies burung di dalam keluarga Dicaeidae. Burung ini endemik di Sulawesi dan Kepulauan Sula.

species.name: Pecuk-Padi Belang
species.summary: Pecuk-padi belang (Microcarbo melanoleucos), atau juga dikenal sebagai pecuk belang kecil, adalah sejenis burung laut anggota suku Phalacrocoracidae. Berwarna hitam dan putih, pecuk ini biasa ditemukan di badan-badan air di pesisir di wilayah Australasia.

species.name: Daralaut kumis
species.summary: Dara-laut kumis (Chlidonias hybrida) adalah spesies burung yang termasuk dalam famili Sternidae. Burung ini adalah burung pengunjung tetap di Sumatra, Jawa, dan Bali pada musim dingin, tetapi beberapa di antaranya juga sering terlihat pada musim panas.

species.name: Bondol Taruk
species.summary: The black-faced munia (Lonchura molucca) is a species of estrildid finch found in Indonesia. Other common names include tricoloured munia or chestnut munia. It occurs in a wide range of habitats including artificial landscapes (e.g. parks and gardens), forest, grassland and savannah.

species.name: Perling Kecil
species.summary: The short-tailed starling (Aplonis minor) is a species of starling in the family Sturnidae. It is found in Indonesia and the Philippines.

species.name: Elang hitam
species.summary: The black eagle (Ictinaetus malaiensis) is a bird of prey. Like all eagles, it is in the family Accipitridae, and is the only member of the genus Ictinaetus. They soar over forests in the hilly regions of tropical and subtropical South and Southeast Asia, as well as southeastern China.

species.name: Sikatan Bodoh
species.summary: The snowy-browed flycatcher (Ficedula hyperythra) is a species of bird in the family Muscicapidae.

species.name: Pelanduk Sulawesi
species.summary: The Sulawesi babbler (Pellorneum celebense) is a species of bird in the family Pellorneidae. It is endemic to Indonesia.

species.name: Raja-Udang Meninting
species.summary: Raja-udang Meninting (Alcedo meninting) berasal dari Asia, tersebar melewati Subkontinen India dan Asia Tenggara. Persebarannya dari barat India, ke arah timur Nepal, Bhutan dan Bangladesh, menuju ke Myanmar, Thailand, Kamboja, Vietnam dan Malaysia.

species.name: Bangkong Kolong
species.summary: Bangkong kolong atau kodok rumah memiliki nama ilmiah Bufo melanostictus Schneider. Kodok ini juga dikenal dengan beberapa nama lain seperti kodok buduk (Btw.), kodok berut/kerok, kodok kintêl (Jw.), kodok brama (Jw., yang berwarna kemerahan), dan Asian black-spined toad (Ingg.).

species.name: Cabai panggul-kuning
species.summary: Cabai panggul-kuning (Dicaeum aureolimbatum) adalah spesies burung pengicau dalam famili Dicaeidae. Cabai panggul-kuning adalah spesies burung endemik di Sulawesi.

species.name: Cerek Kernyut
species.summary: The Pacific golden plover (Pluvialis fulva) is a medium-sized plover. The genus name is Latin and means relating to rain, from pluvia, "rain". It was believed that golden plovers flocked when rain was imminent. The species name fulva is Latin and refers to a tawny colour.

species.name: Mandar-Padi Zebra
species.summary: Mandar-padi zebra (Gallirallus torquatus) adalah spesies burung yang tergolong famili Rallidae. Burung ini tersebar di Indonesia dan Filipina.

species.name: Gagang-Bayam Timur
species.summary: Gagang-bayam timur (bahasa Latin = Himantopus leucocephalus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Recurvirostridae, dari genus Himantopus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan invertebrata kecil yang memiliki habitat di rawa payau, rawa tawar, danau dangkal, tepi sungai, sawah, beting lumpur, tambak garam.

species.name: Cecak tembok
species.summary: Hemidactylus platyurus, commonly known as the flat-tailed house gecko, is a species of Gekkonidae native to southeastern and southern Asia. The species is sometimes classified under the genus Cosymbotus.

species.name: Pecukular asia
species.summary: Pecuk-ular asia (bahasa Latin = Anhinga melanogaster) adalah salah satu spesies burung Pecuk ular. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ikan yang memiliki habitat di pada genangan air luas, danau, sungai besar. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.400 m dpl.

species.name: Bengkarung
species.summary: Kadal kebun alias bengkarung biasa adalah sejenis reptil berkaki empat anggota suku Scincidae (kadal sejati). Disebut kadal kebun, karena bengkarung biasa dijumpai di kebun pekarangan.

species.name: Raja-Udang Erasia
species.summary: Raja-udang eurasia (Alcedo atthis) juga diketahui sebagai Raja-udang biasa atau Raja-udang sungai, adalah raja-udang kecil dengan tujuh subspesies yang diakui dalam distribusi yang luas di seluruh Eurasia dan Afrika Utara.

species.name: Trinil Kaki-Hijau
species.summary: Trinil kaki-hijau (bahasa Latin = Tringa nebularia) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Tringa. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ikan, berudu, krustasea, cacing, larva serangga yang memiliki habitat di rawa, gosong lumpur, tambak.

species.name: Ayam hutan merah
species.summary: Ayam hutan merah atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Gallus gallus adalah sejenis burung berukuran sedang, dengan panjang sekitar 78 cm, dari suku Phasianidae. Ayam betina berukuran lebih kecil, dengan panjang sekitar 46 cm.

species.name: Katak-Pohon Bergaris
species.summary: Katak-pohon bergaris adalah nama sejenis kodok yang biasa hidup di pohon. Kodok ini juga disebut dalam beberapa bahasa daerah sebagai gedindang atau cekay (Sd.), perkak (Bms.), bencok (Jw.), dan lain-lain.

species.name: Kancilan Perut-Kuning
species.summary: The sulphur-vented whistler or sulphur-bellied whistler (Pachycephala sulfuriventer) is a species of bird in the family Pachycephalidae. It is endemic to Sulawesi in Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.

species.name: Mandar Batu
species.summary: Mandar batu (bahasa Latin = Gallinula chloropus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Rallidae, dari genus Gallinula. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga air, binatang kecil, pucuk tanaman muda yang memiliki habitat di danau, kolam, parit, sawah, tambak payau, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.200 m dpl.

species.name: Kedasi Laut
species.summary: The little bronze cuckoo (Chrysococcyx minutillus) is a species of cuckoo in the family Cuculidae. It is found in Southeast Asia, New Guinea and northern and eastern Australia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. This is the world's smallest cuckoo, at 17 grams and 15 cm (6 in).

species.name: Kicuit Kerbau
species.summary: The eastern yellow wagtail (Motacilla tschutschensis) is a small passerine in the wagtail family Motacillidae, which also includes the pipits and longclaws. It was often classified as a subspecies of the Western yellow wagtail.
Bilbong pendeta (Streptocitta albicolis) adalah spesies burung dari famili Sturnidae. Burung ini endemik di pulau Sulawesi, Lembeh, Togian, Muna, dan Butung.

species.name: Jalak Alis-Api
species.summary: Jalak alis-api (Enodes erythrophris) adalah spesies burung jalak dalam famili Sturnidae. Burung ini endemik di Pulau Sulawesi, menghuni hutan pegunungan dataran tinggi.

species.name: Mandar-Padi Kalung-Kuning
species.summary: The buff-banded rail (Gallirallus philippensis) is a distinctively coloured, highly dispersive, medium-sized rail of the rail family, Rallidae.

species.name: Layang-Layang Batu
species.summary: Layang-layang batu (Hirundo javanica) atau dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal juga sebagai Pacific Swallow adalah spesies burung dalam famili Hirundinidae. Burung ini tersebar luas dari Asia Selatan hingga Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Myzomela sulawesi
species.summary: Cui-cui sulawesi (Myzomela chloroptera) adalah burung penghisap madu dalam famili Meliphagidae. Burung ini endemik di Indonesia, tersebar terbatas di Sulawesi, Taliabu, Selayar, dan Tanah Jampea.

species.name: Belibis Kembang
species.summary: Belibis kembang (Dendrocygna arcuata) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Anatidae. Burung ini tersebar di Filipina, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Jawa, Nusa Tenggara, Maluku, Papua, Australia, dan Britania Baru.

species.name: Trinil Kaki-Merah
species.summary: Trinil kaki-merah (bahasa Latin = Tringa totanus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Tringa. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan cacing, moluska, krustasea yang memiliki habitat di beting lumpur, pantai, rawa, tambak kering, sawah dekat laut. Kadang dijumpai jauh di pedalaman.

species.name: Biawak Air
species.summary: Varanus salvator, atau lazim dikenal sebagai biawak air atau biawak air asia, adalah kadal besar yang endemik di Asia Selatan dan Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Kongkang Kolam Jawa
species.summary: Kongkang kolam adalah nama sejenis kodok dari suku Ranidae. Nama ilmiahnya adalah Hylarana chalconota Schlegel, 1837. Orang Sunda (Jawa Barat) menyebutnya bangkong kolé. Sedangkan namanya dalam bahasa Inggris adalah white-lipped frog atau copper-cheeked frog.

species.name: Elang tikus
species.summary: Elang tikus (Elanus caeruleus) adalah burung Pemangsa diurnal berukuran kecil dalam familia Accipitridae yang terkenal karena kebiasaannya melayang dalam padang rumput terbuka seperti kebiasaan kestrel yang berukuran kecil.

species.name: Capung-Tengger biru
species.summary: Diplacodes trivialis, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae, known as the chalky percher or ground skimmer. It is found in China, Japan, India and southwards to New Guinea and Australia.

species.name: Cikalang besar
species.summary: Cikalang besar (Fregata minor) adalah spesies burung cikalang dalam famili Fregatidae. Burung ini tersebar di lautan tropis, tempat koloni berbiak terdekat adalah Pulau Chrismast di Samudra Hindia, Pulau Manuk, dan Gunung Api di Laut Banda.

The malia (Malia grata) is a medium-sized (approximately 29 cm long) babbler-like passerine. It has an olive-green plumage, yellowish head and chest, and pinkish-brown bill. The young is duller than adult. It is the only member of the genus Malia.

species.name: Elang paria
species.summary: Elang paria (Milvus migrans) adalah spesies Burung pemangsa dari keluarga Accipitridae. Burung ini dianggap sebagai spesies yang paling melimpah dari keluarga acciptrid, meskipun beberapa jumlah telah mengalami penurunan dramatis.

species.name: Walik Kuping-Merah
species.summary: The red-eared fruit dove (Ptilinopus fischeri) is a species of bird in the pigeon family. It is endemic to the island of Sulawesi, Indonesia.

species.name: Itik Alis
species.summary: The Pacific black duck (Anas superciliosa) is a dabbling duck found in much of Indonesia, New Guinea, Australia, New Zealand, and many islands in the southwestern Pacific, reaching to the Caroline Islands in the north and French Polynesia in the east.

species.name: Kowakmalam merah
species.summary: Kowak-malam merah (Nycticorax caledonicus) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Ardeidae. Burung ini berukuran sedang (50 cm) dengan leher pendek dan paruh panjang. Warna dominan merah karat pada tubuh.
The dark-eared myza (Myza celebensis), also known as the lesser streaked honeyeater, is a species of bird in the family Meliphagidae. It is endemic to the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia.

The cerulean cuckooshrike (Coracina temminckii) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae. It is endemic to the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.

The streak-headed white-eye (Heleia squamiceps), also known as the streaky-headed white-eye or streak-headed ibon, is a species of bird in the family Zosteropidae. It is endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.

species.name: Ular Gadung
species.summary: Ular gadung adalah sejenis ular berbisa lemah yang tidak berbahaya dari suku Colubridae. Secara umum, di wilayah Indonesia barat ular ini disebut dengan nama ular pucuk. Nama-nama daerahnya di antaranya oray pucuk (Sd.), ula gadung (Jw.), dan lain-lain. Dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal sebagai Oriental whip-snake....

species.name: Cekakak Merah
species.summary: Cekakak merah (Halcyon coromanda) adalah spesies burung raja-udang dalam famili Halcyonidae.

species.name: Kerakbasi Ramai
species.summary: The clamorous reed warbler (Acrocephalus stentoreus) is an Old World warbler in the genus Acrocephalus. It breeds from Egypt eastwards through Pakistan, Afghanistan and northernmost India to south China, southeast Asia and south to Australia. A. s. meridionalis is an endemic race in Sri Lanka.

species.name: Trinil Rawa
species.summary: Tringa stagnatilis adalah burung perandai kecil. Ini adalah betis yang agak kecil, dan berkembang biak di padang rumput terbuka dan lahan basah taiga dari Eropa paling timur ke Timur Jauh Rusia.
Junonia orithya adalah salah satu spesies serangga.

species.name: Ibis rokoroko
species.summary: Ibis rokoroko (Plegadis falcinellus) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Threskiornithidae. Burung ini tersebar luas di dunia. Di Indonesia tercatat sebagai burung vagran di Kalimantan Selatan.

species.name: Kedidi Jari-Panjang
species.summary: The long-toed stint, Calidris subminuta, is a small wader. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris, a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds. The specific subminuta is from Latin sub, "near to" and minuta, "small" from its similarity to the little stint, Calidris minuta.

species.name: Capung-Jarum Centil
species.summary: Agriocnemis femina, the variable wisp or pinhead wisp, is a species of damselfly in the family Coenagrionidae. It is a small damselfly; mature males have a white pruinescence over their body, and a dark tail. It is found from India, through South-east Asia to islands in the Pacific.

species.name: Ular Tambang
species.summary: Ular tambang atau Ular tali picis adalah spesies ular pohon dari familia Colubridae. Nama-nama lokal ular ini diantaranya: "ulo tambang" atau "ulo tampar" (Bhs. Jawa), "olar kandilis" (Bhs. Madura) dan "duwata" atau "ule lewora" (Bhs. Toraja).

species.name: Trinil Bedaran
species.summary: Trinil bedaran (bahasa Latin = Xenus cinereus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Xenus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan cacing, krutasea, moluska kecil, binatang laut lain yang memiliki habitat di gosong lumpur, pantai, teluk, muara sungai.

species.name: Cirik-cirik sulawesi
species.summary: Kirik-kirik sulawesi (Meropogon forsteni) adalah spesies burung kirik-kirik dalam suku Meropidae. Burung ini endemik di Pulau Sulawesi, menghuni tepian hutan bekas tebangan dan rumpang di hutan primer dan sekunder yang tinggi, biasanya di lereng-lereng yang curam atau di perbukitan dan pegunungan.

species.name: Kodok Sawah
species.summary: Kodok sawah ialah sejenis katak yang banyak hidup di sawah-sawah, rawa, parit dan selokan, sampai ke rawa-rawa bakau.

Danaus chrysippus adalah spesies serangga yang tersebar luas di Asia, Afrika, dan Australia. Termasuk ke dalam keluarga Danainae dari keluarga kupu-kupu Nymphalidae. Larva Danaus chrysippus utamanya mengkonsumsi tanaman dalam genus Asclepias, lebih sering disebut milkweed (getah susu) seperti pohon widuri.
Pergam kepala-kelabu (Ducula radiata) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Columbidae. Burung ini endemik di Pulau Sulawesi.

species.name: Kacamata Makassar
species.summary: The black-ringed white-eye or lemon-throated white-eye (Zosterops anomalus) is a species of bird in the family Zosteropidae. It is endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Kongkang Gading
species.summary: Kongkang gading adalah nama sejenis kodok dari suku Ranidae. Nama ilmiahnya adalah Rana erythraea (Schlegel, 1837), yakni berasal dari nama sebuah kota kecil di Asia Tengah (Iskandar, 1998). Dalam bahasa Inggris, dikenal dengan nama golden-lined frog, green paddy frog, green lotus frog atau common greenback.

Melanitis leda, the common evening brown, is a common species of butterfly found flying at dusk. The flight of this species is erratic. They are found in Africa, South Asia and South-east Asia extending to parts of Australia.

species.name: Cecak Gula
species.summary: The four-clawed gecko (Gehyra mutilata, also known as the stump-toed gecko, tender-skinned house gecko, sugar lizard, or Pacific gecko, or butiki) is a wide-ranging lizard that is probably native to Southeast Asia. It has made its way to several areas of the world including Sri Lanka, Indochina, and many of the U.S.

species.name: Capung-Sambar Senja
species.summary: Tholymis tillarga, the coral-tailed cloudwing, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is found from tropical West Africa to Asia, Australia and the Pacific Islands. Common names include old world twister, evening skimmer, crepuscular darter, and foggy-winged twister.

species.name: Belentung
species.summary: Belentung atau belentuk adalah nama sejenis kodok kecil yang bersuara nyaring. Karena bunyi dengkungnya itu, banyak orang yang menyangka hewan ini bertubuh besar (lihat misalnya pada KBBI). Orang Jakarta menyebutnya kodok blentung, sedangkan orang Jawa menamainya kintel.

species.name: Codot Krawar
species.summary: Codot krawar (Cynopterus brachyotis) adalah sejenis kelelawar anggota suku codot (Pteropodidae). Kelelawar pemakan buah ini hidup tersebar luas mulai dari Nepal, India, Sri Lanka, Asia Tenggara, Filipina, dan Indonesia (Sumatra, Kalimantan, Jawa, Bali, dan Maluku).

species.name: Bondol-hijau Bambu
species.summary: The tawny-breasted parrotfinch (Erythrura hyperythra) is a common species of estrildid finch found in Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines. It has an estimated global extent of occurrence of 1,000,000 - 10,000,000 km2.

species.name: Kuntul belang
species.summary: Kuntul belang (Ardea picata) adalah spesies burung kuntul dalam famili Ardeidae. Burung ini tersebar di Australia, Sulawesi Selatan Papua, Maluku dan Kepulauan Tanimbar.

species.name: Perling Kumbang
species.summary: Perling kumbang (Aplonis panayensis) adalah spesies burung dari famili jalak-jalakan (Sturnidae). Tersebar luas di Asia Selatan dan Asia Tenggara. Hidup berkelompok, kerap datang berkunjung dan menetap di area perkotaan yang memiliki pohon berbuah kecil seperti beringin.

species.name: Mandar Kelam
species.summary: Mandar kelam (Gallinula tenebrosa) adalah spesies burung mandar dalam famili Rallidae. Burung ini tersebar di Indonesia, Australia, dan Selandia Baru.

Pari tutul-biru ekor-pita (Taeniura lymma) adalah sebuah spesies pari myliobatoid pada famili Dasyatidae. Pari ini dapat ditemukan dari zona intertidal hingga kedalaman 30 m, dan sering dijumpai diseluruh Samudra Pasifik barat dan Samudera Hindia tropis didekat pesisir dan habitat-habitat dekat terumbu karang.

species.name: Jalak tunggir-merah
species.summary: Jalak tunggir-merah (Scissirostrum dubium) adalah spesies burung jalak dalam famili Sturnidae. Burung ini endemik di Pulau Sulawesi termasuk pulau-pulau satelitnya dan Kepulauan Banggai.
The red-backed buttonquail (Turnix maculosus) is a species of bird in the family Turnicidae. It is found in Australia, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines and the Solomon Islands.
Emoia caeruleocauda adalah spesies kadal dalam famili Scincidae.

species.name: Kupu-kupu raja helena
species.summary: Troides helena merupakan spesies kupu-kupu besar yang juga disebut Common Birdwing. Troides helena pertama kali di deskripsikan oleh Linnaeus pada tahun 1758. Bentangan sayapnya berkisar antara 13 sampai 17 cm. Kupu-kupu ini termasuk dalam suku Troidini pada family Papilionidae.

Orthetrum serapia known as the green skimmer is a freshwater dragonfly in the Libellulidae family. The serapia species is present in Australia, the Philippines, Fiji, Papua New Guinea and Solomon Islands. It inhabits a wide range of still and sluggish waters, often shallow.

species.name: Tikus rumah
species.summary: Tikus rumah (Rattus rattus) adalah hewan pengerat biasa yang mudah dijumpai di rumah-rumah dengan ekor yang panjang dan pandai memanjat serta melompat. Hewan ini termasuk dalam subsuku Murinae dan berasal dari Asia.

species.name: Gabus
species.summary: Channa striata, the striped snakehead, is a species of snakehead fish. It is also known as the common snakehead, chevron snakehead and snakehead murrel. It is native to South and Southeast Asia, and has been introduced to some Pacific Islands (reports from Madagascar and Hawaii are misidentifications of C. maculata).

The Emerald Tree Skink (Lamprolepis smaragdina), sometimes (ambiguously) known as "green tree skink" or "emerald green skink". It is a non-threatened species although it not commonly seen but it is however, becoming more and more popular in the exotic pet trade.
Limnonectes modestus is a species of frog in the Dicroglossidae family. It is endemic to Indonesia.
Siganus virgatus is a species of marine fish of the family Siganidae, order Perciformes, suborder Acanthuroidei.

species.name: Ular Segitiga Merah
species.summary: Ular segitiga-merah adalah spesies Natricinae yang terdapat di India hingga kepulauan Nusantara. Dinamakan "ular segitiga-merah" karena ular ini memiliki motif-motif berbentuk segitiga berwarna merah di sisi badannya. Nama umumnya dalam bahasa Inggris adalah Triangle keelback.

species.name: Ular Kawat
species.summary: Ular kawat biasa (Indotyphlops braminus), juga sering disebut ular cacing atau ular kawat saja, adalah salah satu jenis ular yang terkecil di dunia. Nama-namanya dalam bahasa Inggris adalah common blindsnake, Brahminy blindsnake, flowerpot snake, bootlace snake. Dalam bahasa Jawa ia juga dikenal sebagai ula duwel.

species.name: Kodok Sulawesi
species.summary: Kodok Sulawesi (Ingerophrynus celebensis) adalah spesies katak dari keluarga Bufonidae. Ini adalah endemik Sulawesi Indonesia .

species.name: Ular Pelangi
species.summary: Ular pelangi adalah sejenis ular yang termasuk anggota suku Xenopeltidae. Ular ini diberi nama demikian karena lapisan transparan pada sisiknya membiaskan warna-warni pelangi dari cahaya matahari. Dalam bahasa Inggris ia disebut dengan nama sunbeam snake atau iridescent earth snake.

species.name: Cecadu-Pisang Kecil
species.summary: Cecadu-pisang kecil (Macroglossus minimus) adalah sebuah spesies kalong. M. minimus menjadi salah satu spesies terkecil di famili Pteropodidae, dengan panjang rata-rata yaitu 60–85 mm. Kalong ini berbulu cokelat kemerahan dengan bulu yang relatif panjang dibandingkan spesies lainnya.
The orange-spotted spinefoot, Siganus guttatus, is a rabbitfish from the eastern Indian Ocean. It occasionally makes its way into the aquarium trade. It grows to 42 cm in length.

species.name: Burung-Sepatu Jengger
species.summary: Burung-sepatu jengger ( Irediparra gallinacea ) adalah spesies burung pantai dalam famili Jacanidae.
Tropidolaemus subannulatus is a venomous pit viper species native to Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines.

Ular cincin-emas atau yang juga dikenal dengan nama ular tali wangsa atau ular bakau (nama yang juga digunakan untuk spesies F. leucobalia), adalah spesies ular berbisa menengah dari suku Colubridae. Ular ini diberi nama ular cincin-emas karena belang-belang berwarna kuning emas yang terdapat di punggungnya.

species.name: Kadal Serasah Cokelat
species.summary: Kadal serasah cokelat (Eutropis rudis) adalah sejenis kadal anggota suku Scincidae. Reptil ini menyebar mulai dari Kepulauan Nikobar di barat, Sumatra, Kepulauan Mentawai, Jawa, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Kepulauan Sulu, dan Filipina..
Ular-pohon cokelat adalah sejenis ular kucing dari genus Boiga yang terdapat di Indonesia Timur, Australia, dan Kepulauan Melanesia. Ular ini juga menjadi spesies invasif di Guam.

species.name: Ikan Nila
species.summary: Ikan nila adalah sejenis ikan konsumsi air tawar. Ikan ini diintroduksi dari Afrika, tepatnya Afrika bagian timur, pada tahun 1969, dan kini menjadi ikan peliharaan yang populer di kolam-kolam air tawar di Indonesia sekaligus hama di setiap sungai dan danau Indonesia.
Graphium rhesus is a butterfly found in the Sunda Islands of the Malay Archipelago that belongs to the swallowtail family.

Draco spilonotus, the Sulawesi lined gliding lizard, is a lizard native to Sulawesi. The patagium of the male is yellow in colour, with a network of brown lines radiating from the anterior. The gular flag is yellow, and rounded in shape.

species.name: Gupi
species.summary: The guppy (Poecilia reticulata), also known as millionfish and rainbow fish, is one of the world's most widely distributed tropical fish, and one of the most popular freshwater aquarium fish species. It is a member of the family Poeciliidae and, like almost all American members of the family, is live-bearing.

Emoia atrocostata, commonly known as the mangrove skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. It inhabits mangroves, back-beach vegetation and rocky shorelines. It is semi-aquatic and forages in tidal pools.

species.name: Biawak togian
species.summary: The Togian water monitor (Varanus togianus) is a species of monitor lizard.
Graphium meyeri is a species of butterfly of the family Papilionidae, that is found in Sulawesi. Very little is known about this species.
Polypedates iskandari is a species of frog in the family Rhacophoridae. It is endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia.

species.name: Celurut Rumah Asia
species.summary: Celurut rumah, cencurut rumah, cecurut rumah, atau munggis rumah adalah sejenis mamalia pemakan serangga (insektivora) bertubuh kecil.

species.name: Susuh Duri
species.summary: Mieniplotia is a genus of freshwater snails in the family Thiaridae. It is monotypic, the sole species being Mieniplotia scabra (O. F. Müller, 1774).

species.name: Ular Air Kelabu
species.summary: Ular-air kelabu (Hypsiscopus plumbea) adalah sejenis ular yang acap didapati di sawah-sawah, saliran dan kolam-kolam ikan, anggota suku Homalopsidae. Ular kecil ini menyebar di anak-benua India dan Asia Tenggara termasuk Kepulauan Nusantara.

species.name: Itik Alas-Putih
species.summary: The garganey (Spatula querquedula) is a small dabbling duck. It breeds in much of Europe and western Asia, but is strictly migratory, with the entire population moving to southern Africa, India (in particular Santragachi), and Australasia in winter, where large flocks can occur.

species.name: Trinil Rumbai
species.summary: The ruff (Calidris pugnax) is a medium-sized wading bird that breeds in marshes and wet meadows across northern Eurasia. This highly gregarious sandpiper is migratory and sometimes forms huge flocks in its winter grounds, which include southern and western Europe, Africa, southern Asia and Australia.

Tarebia granifera, common name (in the aquarium industry) the quilted melania, is a species of freshwater snail with an operculum, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Thiaridae. This snail is native to south-eastern Asia, but it has become established as an invasive species in numerous other areas.

species.name: Cicak Terbang
species.summary: Gekko kuhli, commonly known as Kuhl's flying gecko or the common flying gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Asia.

Indoplanorbis is a genus of air-breathing freshwater snail. Its only member species is Indoplanorbis exustus, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Planorbidae, the ram's horn snails. The species is widely distributed across the tropics.

Eurema alitha, the scalloped grass yellow, is a butterfly species in the genus Eurema. It was first described as Terias alitha by father and son entomologists Cajetan and Rudolf Felder in 1862. It is found in Southeast Asia.

Papilio blumei, the peacock or green swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae. It is found only on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi. It is sometimes confused with the more widespread P. palinurus, but that species is smaller and has mostly black tails (in P.

Sicyopus zosterophorus is a species of amphidromous goby in the family Oxudercidae. It is widely distributed throughout the Indo-Pacific region, where it inhabits clear, fast-flowing streams, particularly in forested areas with rocky substrates.

Eurema tominia adalah spesies kupu-kupu asli Indonesia dan Malaysia. Berbeda dengan spesies Eurema pada umumnya, sebagian besar Eurema tominia terbang rendah dekat dengan tanah di daerah terbuka dan hanya terkadang terbang tinggi di pohon. Spesies Eurema tominia dewasa lebih sering tinggal di bagian bawah daun.

species.name: Bandeng
species.summary: The milkfish (Chanos chanos) is the sole living species in the family Chanidae. However, there are at least five extinct genera from the Cretaceous.

species.name: Kepudang-sungu kerdil
species.summary: The pygmy cuckooshrike (Celebesica abbotti) is a species of bird in the cuckooshrike family Campephagidae. It is endemic to the Indonesian island of Sulawesi. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.
Graphium deucalion, the yellow zebra, is a butterfly found in the Sunda Islands and the Moluccas that belongs to the swallowtail family. It is not known to be threatened.
The Kabaena bow-fingered gecko (Cyrtodactylus jellesmae) is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Indonesia.

species.name: Kupu-kupu raja haliphron
species.summary: Troides haliphron, the haliphron birdwing, is a birdwing butterfly confined to Sulawesi and the lesser Sunda Islands.

species.name: Lemadang
species.summary: The mahi-mahi (/ˈmɑːhiːˈmɑːhiː/) or common dolphinfish (Coryphaena hippurus) is a surface-dwelling ray-finned fish found in off-shore temperate, tropical and subtropical waters worldwide.

Macrobrachium lar is a species of freshwater shrimp found throughout the Indo-West Pacific area, ranging from East Africa through to the Marquesas Islands and was first described in 1798. This species is found in flowing rivers and creeks near sea level.

species.name: Paniki Pallas
species.summary: Paniki pallas (Nyctimene cephalotes), atau yang juga dikenal dengan nama paniki torresian atau paniki utara, adalah sebuah spesies codot pada genus Nyctimene yang ditemukan di Indonesia. Sebarannya barangkali meluas sampai ke Nugini, namun penampakan-penampakannya dapat berupa misidentifikasi.

Tongkol lisong atau lisong (Auxis rochei) adalah sejenis ikan laut anggota suku Scombridae. Ikan yang tergolong dalam kelompok tuna ini menyebar luas di perairan tropika. Dalam bahasa Inggris, lisong dikenal sebagai Bullet tuna atau Bullet mackerel, merujuk pada bentuk tubuhnya yang serupa peluru atau torpedo.
The Polynesian rat, or Pacific rat (Rattus exulans), known to the Māori as kiore, is the third most widespread species of rat in the world behind the brown rat and black rat.

species.name: Musang Tenggalung
species.summary: The Malay civet (Viverra tangalunga), also known as the Malayan civet and Oriental civet, is a viverrid native to the Malay Peninsula and the islands of Sumatra, Bangka, Borneo, the Rhio-Lingga Archipelago, and the Philippines.

Papurana celebensis, also known as the Celebes frog, is a species of true frog in the family Ranidae. Prior to being reclassified into the genus Papurana in 2020, it was referred to as "Hylarana" celebensis. It is endemic to Sulawesi (Celebes), Indonesia.
Bronchocela celebensis, the Sulawesi bloodsucker, is a species of lizard. It is endemic to Indonesia. It is closely related to Bronchocela jubata and other lizards of the Bronchocela genus.

Rhacophorus edentulus (Celebes flying frog) is a species of frog in the Rhacophoridae family endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia. Its natural habitats are rivers, freshwater marshes, and intermittent freshwater marshes.
Coelognathus erythrurus, commonly known as the Philippine rat snake, is a species of snake of the family Colubridae.
The Sulawesi striped blue crow (Euploea configurata) is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia.

species.name: Kubu Sulawesi
species.summary: Kubu sulawesi (Dobsonia exoleta) adalah spesies kelelawar raksasa dalam famili Pteropodidae. Kelelawar ini endemik ke Indonesia.
Graphium dorcus, or Tabitha's swordtail, is a butterfly found in Sulawesi, Indonesia, that belongs to the swallowtail family. The species was first described by Wilhem de Haan in 1840.
Draco walkeri is a species of agamid lizard. It is found in Indonesia.
Papilio helenus, the red Helen, is a large swallowtail butterfly found in forests of southern India and parts of Southeast Asia.
Ptyas dipsas, the Sulawesi black racer, is a species of snake of the family Colubridae.
Sphenomorphus variegatus is a species of skink. It is found throughout most of the Philippines, and in some parts of Malaysia (Borneo) and Indonesia (Sulawesi).

Holothuria fuscocinerea, the ashy pink sea cucumber, is a species of sea cucumber in the family Holothuriidae. It is placed in the subgenus Stauropora, making its full name Holothuria (Stauropora) fuscocinerea. It is native to shallow water in the tropical and sub-tropical Indo-Pacific.

Mencit (Mus musculus) adalah anggota Muridae (tikus-tikusan) yang berukuran kecil. Mencit mudah dijumpai di rumah-rumah dan dikenal sebagai hewan pengganggu karena kebiasaannya menggigiti mebel dan barang-barang kecil lainnya, serta bersarang di sudut-sudut lemari.
Hoffmann's rat (Rattus hoffmanni) is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is found only in Indonesia, and is located throughout Sulawesi, as well as Malenge island in the Togian Islands.

Limnonectes larvaepartus is a species of fanged frogs in the family Dicroglossidae endemic to northern and western Sulawesi, Indonesia. It is unique in that it has internal fertilization and gives live birth to tadpoles. Other frog species that have live birth produce froglets.

species.name: Tikus Sawah
species.summary: Tikus sawah, Rattus argentiventer, adalah tikus yang mudah dijumpai di pedesaan dan perkotaan di penjuru Asia Tenggara dan Asia.

The Malayan field rat, Malaysian field rat or Malaysian wood rat, (Rattus tiomanicus) is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is nocturnal and mainly arboreal and is found in Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and the Philippines.
Codot walet(Thoopterus nigrescens) adalah sebuah spesies kelelawar besar dalam famili Pteropodidae.

Occidozyga semipalmata is a species of frog in the family Dicroglossidae. It is endemic to western and northern Sulawesi, Indonesia. It has been found in Gunung Lombobatang Natural Reserve, Lore Lindu National Park, and Bogani Nani Wartabone National Park.

The pompano dolphinfish (Coryphaena equiselis) is a species of surface-dwelling ray-finned fish found in tropical and subtropical waters. They are one of only two members of the Coryphaenidae family, the other being the mahi-mahi or common dolphinfish.
Hellwald's spiny rat (Maxomys hellwaldii) is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is found only in Indonesia.
Musschenbroek's spiny rat (Maxomys musschenbroekii) is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is found only in Indonesia.

species.name: Lasiwen Hitam
species.summary: Peters's myotis or small black myotis (Myotis ater) is a species of vesper bat. It is found in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, and the Philippines; its exact distribution is uncertain as it is difficult to distinguish from some other Myotis species.
The Himalayan field rat (Rattus nitidus), sometimes known as the white-footed Indo-Chinese rat, is a species of rodent in the family Muridae.
Rhabdophis chrysargoides, commonly known as the Javanese keelback or Günther's keelback, is a keelback snake in the family Colubridae found in Java, Indonesia.
The loach goby, Rhyacichthys aspro, is a goby belonging to the family Rhyacichthyidae. It is not fished commercially.

species.name: Punai Penganten
species.summary: Punai penganten (Treron griseicauda) adalah spesies burung dalam familia Columbidae. Burung ini termasuk burung endemik Indonesia.

species.name: Kuntul sedang
species.summary: The medium egret (Ardea intermedia), median egret, smaller egret or intermediate egret, is a medium-sized heron. Some taxonomists put the species in the genus Egretta or Mesophoyx. It is a resident breeder in southern and eastern Asia.
Hypolimnas bolina, the great eggfly, common eggfly or in New Zealand the blue moon butterfly is a species of nymphalid butterfly.

The Sulawesi pygmy woodpecker (Yungipicus temminckii), also known as the Sulawesi woodpecker, is a species of bird in the family Picidae. It is endemic to Sulawesi in Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical moist mountains.

species.name: Cecak Kayu
species.summary: The common house gecko (Hemidactylus frenatus) (not to be confused with the Mediterranean species Hemidactylus turcicus known as Mediterranean house gecko), is a reptile native of Southeast Asia. It is also known as the Pacific house gecko, the Asian house gecko, house lizard, or Moon Lizard.

Graphium agamemnon, the tailed jay, is a predominantly green and black tropical butterfly that belongs to the swallowtail family. The butterfly is also called the green-spotted triangle, tailed green jay, or green triangle.

species.name: Kupu-kupu jeruk
species.summary: Kupu-kupu jeruk (Papilio demoleus) adalah sejenis rama-rama dari famili Papilionidae. Dinamai demikian karena ulat kupu-kupu ini biasanya hidup dan menjadi hama di pohon jeruk.

Leptosia nina, the psyche, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae (the sulphurs, yellows and whites) and is found in Southeast Asia and the Indian subcontinent. The upper forewing has a black spot on a mainly white background.
Doleschallia bisaltide, the autumn leaf, is a nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Australasia. In Australia it is also known as the leafwing.

Acraea terpsicore, kupu-kupu kuning kecoklatan, adalah kupu-kupu kecil bersayap kasar berukuran 53–64 milimeter (2,1–2,5 inci) yang umum ditemukan di habitat padang rumput dan semak belukar. Ia termasuk dalam keluarga Nymphalidae atau kupu-kupu berkaki sikat.
Appias libythea, the striped albatross, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Peninsular Malaysia.

Catopsilia pomona, the common emigrant or lemon emigrant, is a medium-sized pierid butterfly found in Asia and parts of Australia. The species gets its name from its habit of migration. Some early authors considered them as two distinct species Catopsilia crocale and Catopsilia pomona.
Ideopsis juventa adalah spesies kupu-kupu dalam famili Nymphalidae. Kupu-kupu ini tersebar di Asia Tenggara hingga Oseania.

species.name: Lebah Madu Timur
species.summary: Lebah madu Asia (Apis cerana), atau yang juga dikenal sebagai lebah madu Asiatik atau lebah madu timur, adalah sebuah spesies lebah madu yang berasal dari Asia Timur, Tenggara dan Selatan, dan keduanya berada pada subgenus yang sama dengan lebah madu barat (Eropa), Apis mellifera.

Argiope appensa adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1842 oleh Walckenaer.

Cosmophasis lami adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Cosmophasis dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1997 oleh Berry, Beatty Prószynski.
Orsotriaena medus is a butterfly found in south Asia, southeast Asia, and Australia. It is the only species in the genus Orsotriaena, first described by Hans Daniel Johan Wallengren in 1858.
Leucauge fastigata, the pear-shaped leucauge, is a species of spiders in the family Tetragnathidae (long-jawed orb weavers). Its native range extends from India to the Philippines and Sulawesi.
Eurema blanda, the three-spot grass yellow, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.
Hierodula patellifera, common name giant Asian mantis, Asian mantis or Indochina mantis, is a species of praying mantis belonging to genus Hierodula.

species.name: Kumbang Tanduk
species.summary: Kumbang tanduk atau bangbung (Oryctes rhinocerus) adalah jenis kumbang badak (Dynastinae) yang tersebar luas di Asia Tenggara, ke timur sampai pulau Irian, ke utara sampai pulau Formosa. Kumbang dewasa berwarna hitam atau cokelat tua. Panjang tubuh 3,5–4,5 cm dengan kepala bertanduk.

Aedes albopictus (Stegomyia albopicta), juga dikenal sebagai nyamuk macan Asia atau nyamuk hutan, adalah nyamuk asli daerah tropis dan subtropis di Asia Tenggara; namun, dalam beberapa dekade terakhir, spesies ini telah menyebar ke banyak negara melalui pengangkutan barang dan perjalanan internasional.
Papilio peranthus is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae. It is found from the Philippines and Malaysia to Indonesia (including Sumatra, Java, Borneo and Sulawesi)
Coenobita rugosus (kelomang keriput) adalah spesies kelomang darat asli Indonesia hanya pada daerah tropis Australia dan timur Afrika pantai barat Pasifik.

Danaus genutia, the common tiger, is one of the common butterflies of India. It belongs to the "crows and tigers", that is, the Danainae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. The butterfly is also called striped tiger in India to differentiate it from the equally common plain tiger, Danaus chrysippus.
Graphium anthedon is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae, that is found in the Sunda Islands in the Malay Archipelago.
Neptis ida, adalah spesies kupu-kupu dalam famili Nymphalidae.
Suastus gremius, the Indian palm bob or palm bob, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.It is found in the Indomalayan realm...

Euthalia aconthea, the common baron, often called simply baron, is a medium-sized nymphalid butterfly native to India and South-East Asia. It flies with stiff wing beats and often glides. The wing is not flapped very far below the horizontal.
Asota heliconia is a moth in the Erebidae family. It is found from the Indo-Australian tropics east to Queensland and the Solomons.
The palm weevil Rhynchophorus vulneratus is one of two species of snout beetle known as the red palm weevil or Asian palm weevil.
Graphium eurypylus, the great jay or pale green triangle, is a species of tropical butterfly belonging to the family Papilionidae.

species.name: Penggulung Daun Pisang
species.summary: Erionota thrax yang umumnya diketahui dengan nama ulat penggulung daun pisang adalah termasuk anggota kupu-kupu yang terdapat dalam familia Hesperiidae. Ia ditemukan dari India, Asia Tenggara hingga Papua New Guinea. Lalu, ke arah China Selatan.
Euploea algea adalah spesies kupu-kupu dalam famili Nymphalidae.
Hebomoia glaucippe, the great orange tip, is a butterfly belonging to the family Pieridae, that is the yellows and whites. It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone and Wallacea.
Dolichoderus thoracicus is a species of ant in the genus Dolichoderus. Described by Smith in 1860, the species is widespread in Asia.

Parawixia dehaani adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.

Lamproptera meges, the green dragontail, is a species of swallowtail butterfly (family Papilionidae) found in parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. There are ten subspecies. A specimen from Java is the type species of the genus.

Papilio gigon merupakan spesies kupu-kupu dari famili Papilionidae. Kupu-kupu ini memiliki sebaran yang terbatas di kawasan kepulauan Indonesia Timur, terutama Sulawesi, Sula dan Talaud, dimana kupu-kupu ini sangat umum ditemukan di kawasan tersebut.
Penthicodes farinosus is a species of planthoppers in the subfamily Aphaeninae (Fulgoridae): with five subspecies distributed in Indo-China and Malesia.
Nyctemera baulus is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from India to Samoa. Records include Queensland, Indonesia and New Guinea.

Aedes aegypti merupakan jenis nyamuk yang dapat membawa virus dengue penyebab penyakit demam berdarah. Selain dengue, A. aegypti juga merupakan pembawa virus demam kuning (yellow fever), chikungunya, dan demam Zika yang disebabkan oleh virus Zika.
Spalgis epeus, the apefly, is a small butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family. It gets its name from the supposed resemblance of its caterpillar to the face of an ape.
Nacaduba berenice, the rounded six-line blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in Southeast Asia.
Danaus ismare, the ismare tiger, is a butterfly found in tropical Indonesia. It belongs to the brush-footed butterflies family.
Mycalesis perseus, atau kupu-kupu Dingy Bush Brown, adalah kupu-kupu yang termasuk dalam famili Nymphalidae dan subfamili Satyrinae.

Parthenos sylvia, the clipper, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South and South-East Asia, mostly in forested areas. The clipper is a fast-flying butterfly and has a habit of flying with its wings flapping stiffly between the horizontal position and a few degrees below the horizontal.
Thorelliola ensifera is a species of jumping spider of the genus Thorelliola. Originally native to Southeast Asia, it has been widely introduced to tropical islands across the Pacific Ocean.
Papilio ascalaphus, the Ascalaphus swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae. It is found in Indonesia and the Philippines.
Graphium androcles, the giant swordtail, is a butterfly of the genus Graphium belonging to the family Papilionidae (swallowtails).
Cyrestis acilia is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It is found in Sulawesi (Endemic Sulawesi mainland, Buton island, Kabaena island and Wowoni island).
Parantica cleona is butterfly endemic to Indonesia which was described by Hans Fruhstorfer in 1892.
Euploea hewitsonii, or Hewitson's dwarf crow, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Remelana jangala, the chocolate royal, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia.
Stenocatantops splendens is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya and eastern Asia.

Xystrocera festiva adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Xystrocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Psilogramma discistriga is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Bangladesh.

Danaus melanippus, the black veined tiger, white tiger, common tiger, or eastern common tiger, is a butterfly species found in tropical Asia which belongs to the "crows and tigers", that is, the danaine group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Scolopendra subspinipes (Vietnamese Centipede) is a species of centipede. The native range is uncertain. The certain natural range is Meganesia and Indomalaya.

Pareronia valeria, the common wanderer or Malayan wanderer, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, and is found in India and Southeast Asia. The butterfly found in India is sometimes considered as a separate species, Pareronia hippia.
Papilio fuscus, the Canopus swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae, that is found on Timor, northern Australia, and New Guinea.

Leucauge decorata the decorative silver orb spider is one of the long-jawed orb weaver spiders. A medium to large sized orb weaving spider, with a body length up to 12 mm long (female). Male to 6 mm. This species has a "point" to the end of the abdomen. Found in Africa, India, south east Asia, also to Australia.

Daphnis hypothous, the jade hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Pieter Cramer in 1780. It is known from Sri Lanka, southern and northern India, Nepal, Myanmar, southern China, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia. It is a rare vagrant to the Western Palaearctic ecozone.
Actias isis is a moth of the family Saturniidae.
Catochrysops panormus, the silver forget-me-not, is a small butterfly found from India to the Philippines and south to Australia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Jamides bochus, the dark cerulean, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Nacaduba kurava, the transparent six-line blue, is a species of Lycaenidae butterfly found in Asia.
Euthalia amanda, the Sulawesi gaudy baron, is butterfly endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia. It was first described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862.
Delias zebuda is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Australasian realm (Celebes, Ternate, Menado).
Hypothecla honos is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It is found on Sulawesi and Banggai.

species.name: Onga Jawa
species.summary: Radix rubiginosa is a species of air-breathing freshwater snail, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod in the family Lymnaeidae, the pond snails.
Taractrocera ardonia is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in Malaysia, Borneo (Kalimantan, Sarawak, Brunei, Sabah) and southern Sulawesi.

Euploea sylvester, the double-branded crow, also known as the two-brand crow in Australia, is a butterfly found in South Asia, Southeast Asia and parts of Australia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Bradybaena similaris, common name the Asian trampsnail, is a species of small, air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Bradybaenidae. It earned the common name based on its origins, and its habit of roosting on freight containers.

Tectocoris diophthalmus, commonly known as the Hibiscus Harlequin Bug or Cotton Harlequin Bug, is a brightly coloured convex and rounded shield-shaped bug with a metallic sheen that grows to about 20 mm. Adult females are mostly orange and males are both blue and red or orange. The colours are quite variable.

Batocera celebiana adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Batocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Psolos fuligo, the coon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. The tips of the forewings diverge outward and is a feature that is clear when they rest on vegetation.

Gasteracantha rubrospinis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1838 oleh Guérin.
Papilio polytes, the common Mormon, is a common species of swallowtail butterfly widely distributed across Asia.

Euploea westwoodii, or Westwood's king crow, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Celebes in the Australasian realm.

Chelisoches morio, commonly known as the black earwig, is a cosmopolitan earwig in the family Chelisochidae. Black earwigs are active at all times of the day, and prefer wet habitats. Adults can grow up to 36 millimetres (1.4 in).
Hippotion brunnea is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Indonesia.

Eucorynus crassicornis is a species of fungus weevil in the beetle family Anthribidae, which was first described in 1801 by Johan Christian Fabricius as Anthribus crassicornis, from specimen(s) collected in Sumatra.

Hippotion rosetta is a species of Sphingid moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from southern Pakistan, India and Sri Lanka, east across Thailand, southern China and Taiwan to southern Japan (the Ryukyu Archipelago) and the Philippines, then south across south-east Asia to the Andaman Islands, eastern Indonesia,…

Cephonodes hylas, the coffee bee hawkmoth, pellucid hawk moth or coffee clearwing, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. A widely distributed moth, it is found in the Near East, Middle East, Africa, India, Sri Lanka, Japan, Southeast Asia and Australia.

The fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) is a species the order of Lepidoptera and is the larval life stage of a fall armyworm moth. It is regarded as a pest and can damage and destroy a wide variety of crops, causing large economic damage.

Acalolepta rusticatrix adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang berasal dari famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Acalolepta, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Rhysida longipes, sometimes known as Minor blue leg, is a species of centipedes in the family Scolopendridae. Three subspecies recognized. It is sometimes used as a pet in some countries.

Scylla serrata atau yang juga dikenal sebagai kepiting-bakau besar (giant mangrove crab, giant mud crab) adalah sejenis kepiting bakau yang menyebar luas mulai dari pantai-pantai Asia Timur, Tenggara, Selatan, hingga ke Laut Merah. Spesies ini tidak didapati di perairan Dangkalan Sunda....
Atrophaneura dixoni is a species of butterfly from the family Papilionidae that is found in northern and central Sulawesi, Indonesia.

Culex quinquefasciatus Say, 1823 (originally named Culex fatigans), commonly known as the southern house mosquito, is a medium-sized mosquito found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is the vector of Wuchereria bancrofti, avian malaria, and arboviruses including St.

Acherontia styx, the lesser death's head hawkmoth or bee robber, is a sphingid moth found in Asia, one of the three species of death's-head hawkmoth. It is very fond of honey, and bee keepers have reported finding dead moths in their hives as a result of bee stings.
Ambulyx celebensis is a species of moth in the family Sphingidae. It was described by Jordan in 1919, and is known from Indonesia.
Papilio veiovis is a species of swallowtail butterfly from the genus Papilio that is found in Sulawesi.
Coenobita cavipes is a species of land hermit crab native to the eastern parts of Africa, the Philippines, China, Japan, Malaysia, Taiwan, Polynesia, and Micronesia.
Vanessa buana, the Lompobatang lady, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family found on Sulawesi in Indonesia.
Daphnis protrudens is a moth of the family Sphingidae.

species.name: Entung Jati
species.summary: Hyblaea puera, commonly known as the teak defoliator, is a moth native to south-east Asia. The species has also been recently reported to be present in Central America and Africa. The caterpillar feeds on teak and other species of trees common in the region, considered as one of the major teak pests around the world.
Hotea curculionoides is a species of shield-backed bugs belonging to the family Scutelleridae.
Percnon planissimum or flat rock crab is a species of Percnon crab found in the Indo-Pacific from Somalia to Cocos Islands, the Philippines and Kermadec Islands.
Acosmeryx beatae is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi.
Odontolabis dalmani is a species of beetles belonging to the family Lucanidae.
Euchomenella heteroptera is a species of mantis, also known as the "giraffe mantis", in the family Deroplatyidae.
Asota dohertyi is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Walter Rothschild in 1897. It is found on Sulawesi.
Delias melusina is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Otto Staudinger in 1890. It is found in the Australasian realm, where it is endemic to Sulawesi.

Hypospila bolinoides is a species of moth in the family Erebidae. The species is found from the Indo-Australian tropics of India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Andaman Islands, China north to Japan and east to New Guinea, Queensland and the Carolines.
Leptomyrmex fragilis is a species of ant in the genus Leptomyrmex, commonly called ‘spider ants’. Described by Smith in 1859, the species is endemic to Indonesia and New Guinea and the Philippines.

Oryctes gnu, commonly known as Malaysian rhinoceros beetle, is a species of dung beetle native to South Asian and South East Asian countries including: India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Philippines, Thailand, Philippines, and Vietnam. It is also introduced to many parts of the world.
Pythia scarabaeus is a species of air-breathing saltmarsh snail, a pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Ellobiidae....

Scylla olivacea atau yang juga dikenal sebagai kepiting-bakau jingga (Ingg.: orange mangrove crab, orange mud crab) adalah sejenis kepiting bakau yang paling umum dijual di pasar-pasar Asia Tenggara, terutama Thailand dan wilayah Dangkalan Sunda.

species.summary: Theretra hausmanni is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sulawesi in Indonesia.

Parastasia confluens is a species of beetle of the family Scarabaeidae. It is found in India (Andaman and Nicobar Islands), Indonesia (Aru, Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi, Saleyer, Sangir, Batjan, Ambon, Seram, Ternate), Malaysia (including Sarawak), the Philippines (Luzon) and Papua New Guinea.
Teleogryllus commodus, commonly known as the black field cricket is a cricket species native to Australia.They are significant pests to most plants in Australia and New Zealand. T.

Vespa fervida is a rare species of hornet endemic to parts of Indonesia, primarily on the island of Sulawesi. Its range is quite small, with scattered populations and nesting colonies found on very rare occasions.
Sulawesiella rafaelae is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae, and the only species in the genus Sulawesiella. It was described by Lansberge in 1885.
Nemophas grayii is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Francis Polkinghorne Pascoe in 1859, originally under the genus Monohammus. It is known from Moluccas.
Aedes vexans, the inland floodwater mosquito, is a cosmopolitan and common pest mosquito.

species.name: Kekep Babi
species.summary: Kekep babi (bahasa Latin: Artamus leucorynchus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Artamidae, dari genus Artamus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil, kumbang, leba dan memiliki habitat di pesisir, sawah, kebun, tegalan, hutan sekunder. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.
Cicindela mamasa is a species of tiger beetle. This species is found in Indonesia, where it has been recorded from Sulawesi.
Culex sitiens is an insect native to coastal areas of East Africa and Madagascar, southwestern Asia, Ryukyu Archipelago, Korea, northern Australia and South Pacific islands.
Lohora ophthalmica is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It is found in north-eastern Sulawesi (Sulawesi mainland, the islands of Buton and Kabaena).
Mansonia (Mansonioides) uniformis is a species of zoophilic mosquito belonging to the genus Mansonia.
